page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn7i family, powered by a KVM hypervisor. The system features 128 dedicated physical cores utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. It is equipped with 752.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.88 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, the instance bundles four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, requiring external storage solutions, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-threaded and memory performance. The instance achieves a top-tier rating in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 575.13 GB/sec. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng is measured at 123,935.69, placing it in the top 25% of tested servers. Memory bandwidth is also highly efficient, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 6,856.96 GB/sec and large block uncached read bandwidth at 253.9 GB/sec. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core scoring 1,882.5 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 28.11 GB/sec, both falling within the average range.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers high resource density by combining a large dedicated CPU core count with multiple enterprise-grade GPUs and substantial memory bandwidth. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, meaning storage-heavy operations must rely on network-attached storage, which may impact overall I/O latency. Given the hardware profile and benchmark strengths, this server is suited for GPU-accelerated compute tasks, multi-threaded data processing, high-throughput Redis database operations, and high-volume static web serving.
